head: codex/5627-csdlc-four-command-lifecycle
title: fix(csdlc-v2): collapse routine lifecycle into four commands
body:
Closes #5627

Collapses the normal post-implementation lifecycle into finalize, review, publish, and closeout while preserving atomic validation, exact scoped review, governed publication identity, and terminal receipt integrity. One-shot request payloads now live in overwriteable shared Git state.
